title: Mathematical Transfer in LLMs Follows Reasoning Approach More Than Topic
abstract: arXiv:2610.00331v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When selecting mathematical training data for LLMs, a natural organizing principle is topic: probability examples for probability targets. An alternative is reasoning approach: worked solutions that share a solution method with the target, even when the mathematical domain differs. We ask which relation produces greater transfer after fine-tuning. We evaluate two counterbalanced $2\times2$ designs: probability and combinatorics crossed with invariant reasoning and double counting (2,000 problems), and number theory and geometry crossed with complement and pigeonhole reasoning (800 problems). In each design, every cell serves as the held-out target in turn: same-approach (SA) sources share the target's method but change the topic, while same-topic (ST) sources share the topic but change the method. translated_title: 大语言模型中的数学迁移更多取决于推理方法而非主题
translated_abstract: 在为大语言模型（LLM）选择数学训练数据时，一个自然的组织原则是主题，即为概率目标提供概率类例题。另一种替代原则是推理方法，即选用与目标共享解题方法的详细解答，即使两者的数学领域不同。我们探究哪种关系在微调后能产生更大的迁移效果。我们评估了两个平衡的2×2实验设计：概率与组合数学分别与不变量推理和重复计数推理交叉（2,000道题目），以及数论与几何分别与补集推理和鸽笼原理推理交叉（800道题目）。在每个设计中，每个单元格轮流作为留出的目标：同方法（SA）来源与目标共享解题方法但主题不同，而同主题（ST）来源与目标主题相同但解题方法不同。每个来源在每个角色中仅出现一次，因此在等权重的总体对比中，来源质量的加性效应得以抵消。在五个基础模型上……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究通过两个平衡的2×2交叉实验设计发现，微调后大语言模型的数学迁移效果主要取决于训练数据与目标是否共享推理方法，而非是否共享数学主题。
en_tdlr: Using two counterbalanced 2×2 designs, this study shows that mathematical transfer in fine-tuned LLMs is driven more by shared reasoning approaches between training data and targets than by shared mathematical topics.
